data.title: Suspicious "Vehicle Data Update" Payment Demand (Vorgang ZFD-26-118407)
data.summary: An entity calling itself "Zentralregister Fahrzeugdaten Deutschland" claims that the registration data for vehicle MQ-BQ 207 is outdated and demands an €89.00 "update fee" by 30 November 2026, to be paid to a Lithuanian IBAN held by a private person. This letter shows strong indicators of being a scam.
data.explanation: This letter claims your vehicle's registration data is outdated and threatens that registration could be suspended if you don't pay a fee. Several details strongly suggest this is a scam: no real German vehicle authority charges a private "Halterdaten-Aktualisierungsgebühr", the payment goes to a foreign (Lithuanian) account held by an individual rather than a public account, and the sender name does not match any official registry. Do not transfer the money. If you want to be sure, contact your local vehicle registration office (Zulassungsstelle) yourself using contact details you look up independently, not those printed in this letter. Consider reporting this letter to consumer protection (Verbraucherzentrale) or the police as a suspected scam.

items.title: Alleged "vehicle data update fee"
items.action: Do not pay this demand; verify independently with your local vehicle registration office (Zulassungsstelle) before taking any action.
items.consequence: The letter claims the case will be reported to the registration authority if unpaid, but this threat is likely false and used to pressure payment.

warnings: This letter uses a sender name ("Zentralregister Fahrzeugdaten Deutschland") that does not correspond to any real German vehicle registration authority, and no official authority charges a private fee for "Halterdaten-Aktualisierung".

The requested payment goes to a Lithuanian IBAN made out to an individual ("R. Kazlauskas") rather than a public institution account, which is inconsistent with a German government agency and is a strong scam indicator.

The letter uses pressure (threatening that registration may be suspended from January 2027) typical of scam/phishing letters; do not pay and verify independently with your local Zulassungsstelle before acting.
